reason: Ended by completion of its task under owner rule D-20261108-board-rule (research/readiness/owner_rulings/2026-11-08-haloander-decisions.md item 2) (a): the board was created to investigate the Pan American World Airways dispute and report to the President. The held report of Emergency Board No. 135 (SHA-256 b1d3ce3b1131...) bears the cover date line "JUNE 20, 1961"; the letter of transmittal, which names EO 10919 and submits the report, is dated June 20, 1961 on the page image (text layer: "WASHINGT0/% D.C., June ~0~ 1961."). So the task was performed on 1961-06-20. Disclosed under D-20261125-board-cover-date: the report date is read from the cover, whose date line reads cleanly; the letter of transmittal date line is damaged in the held text layer, and I read the held PDF page image (page 2), which shows "June 20, 1961." The report was made on or about that date; receipt by the President may have been later. The report time was extended once: EO 10926 (signed 1961-03-18, held text, FR page 26 FR 2331) extended until June 20, 1961 the time within which the board created by EO 10919 shall report; the held report (PDF page 8) recites the same order and says the parties had agreed to the extension. The report is dated the last day of the extended time. An extension moves a deadline and does not end the clause; EO 10926 is recorded as a later event. The deadline in the order (thirty days from its date) is not the end. EO:12553 (1986-02-25) stays the formal disposition, recorded as a later event.
